scope_policy: Includes named features, facilities, roads, descriptive historical/geological annotations, printed spot heights and regional title lettering inside the map area. Excludes geological unit codes, dip/strike numerals, report/page references, unnamed symbols, graticule, compass and marginal legend apparatus. Geological words are transcriptions only, with no inferred structural geometry.
